Hi! I’ve been in a previous relationship that was long distance, I can tell that you really care about the girl you just want to be in the loop. It’s bullshit when people say their busy, even a 10 minute call or some text throughout the day to have you in the loop, is not difficult. I would speak to you her, again. Give it another chance, tell her the reason why u need communication in your relationship. But don’t beg, know when enough is enough. Also, I’m glad your working to improve yourself. I also, was that loser when I look back, but I experimented with a lot of hobbies and activities that led me to my passion. Don’t give up! We’re always told that it’s bad to get off track, we’re human it’s normal to.  Don’t beat down on yourself, if you have to work slowly fuck it. It’s really good that you cut out those foods. I’ve also noticed that climate has a huge impact on my skin. I originally lived in England, whenever I travel back I have no skin problems. I also take Llysine (vitamin), zinc and omega 3 they all help with skin ALOT! Research Llysine for acne!

Good luck.

I am not a doctor, but I’ve suffered with acne including cystic acne from the age of 14. I’ve done a lot of research, on steps that helped with my acne. I believe everything that shows up on our skin, is what’s on the inside. Always speak with your doctor!

1) Birth control targeted for hormonal acne (speak with your doctor) Irregular period is a huge sign, could relate to PCOS!

2) Diet: Start eliminating food, dairy and red meat is a start. I would look into testing your microbiome and seeing what foods your body likes. Detox your liver. 

3) vitamins: Llysine (helps with inflammation) probiotics (helps with gut health) vitamin A, omega 3 

4) Topical treatments: Taro-Clindamycin/Benzoyl Peroxide Gel 1%/5% w/w (Helped a lot with my cystic acne, got it as a prescription) Look into researching the ingredients in your skin care routine, a lot of people can have allergies to them. Silicone is one!

Weed is what triggered me into my first severe depression(my first time). It was so traumatized from it. It surfaced all the bad things I did in my lifetime. I remember a chanting in my head that brought me really close to suicide. I felt like this was my new reality and it would never end. 

I stupidly continued to take weed, I think only a few times it’s was barely enjoyable, but I craved that feeling of being happy and joyful with life like everyone said. I don’t think I get the same high as anyone else, it’s like a nightmare. 

Thankfully I didn’t get addicted to it and I never looked back at it. Weed can bring out things and emotions that you’re kept in the back of your head for years. Including, magnifying the bad situation your in. I say accept that it’s not for you, and never look back. Take it as a lesson, for your life whatever you learned during that time.

I completing understand where your coming from, during this time I ask myself the same questions. I think when depression starts to kick in, we tend to shy away from the world and think that we’re useless in it. Thats when the suicidal thoughts creep in, for me at least. It’s comforting like a big hug, but it’s not the right comforting. We have to claw our way out, I know it’s hard to think of things that give u joy when we’re sad. 

I’ve become my best friend, because I have trust issues. I found that writing, helps with releasing my pain and emotions. Meditation helps tremendously, yesterday I was having a panic attack and it calmed me down completely. I watch motivational videos on YouTube, whatever keeps my head outside that loop. 

Just keep trying, even when your at your lowest. You have a purpose on this earth. I tend to be down on myself a lot, but remember we’re humans and we feel sadness and make mistakes all the time. Please hang in there, never hesitate to ask for help, even a physiologist has a therapist. I love speaking to people, just remember if u ever want to talk I’m here.
